headline: Quick Heal Technologies Limited: SEBI Regulation 31(4) Disclosure of Substantial Acquisition
sum: Quick Heal Technologies has filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulation 31(4), indicating a substantial acquisition of shares or voting rights that triggers public disclosure obligations. The identity of the acquirer and transaction value require access to the filed disclosure document.
detail: Quick Heal Technologies submitted a mandatory disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to NSE on or about 19 June 2026. This regulation requires disclosure when a person acquires voting rights that, together with his associates, reach or cross 25%, 35%, 50% or 75% of a company's voting capital. The filing triggers a cascade of further obligations: if the acquiring party has crossed 25%, an open offer becomes mandatory unless exempted.
